issues.detail: The Greek 'ηλιαν' (Hilian) is a specific name/title, but the Vietnamese translates it as 'hắn gọi Ê-li' (he calls Elijah). The Greek text says 'see, Hilian [is] calling' (or 'Hilian calls'), whereas the Vietnamese shifts the action to 'he calls Elijah'. This changes the subject and object of the verb.
